spans.s:
r. 3rd cl. but peculiar to the Vedas (जजन्ति); also (ई) जनी r. 4th cl. (जायते)
1 To be born or produced.
r. 10th cl. (जनयति)
To generate or beget.

m. (-नः)
1 Man, individually or collectively, a man, mankind.
2 The universe.
3 A division of the universe or Loka, the residence of deified mortals: see जनलोक.
4 A low man, a wretch.
f. (-नी)
A mother, &c. see जनि.
f. (-ना)
Birth, production.
E.
जन to be born, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
A father, a progenitor.
2 The name of a king, sovereign of Mithilā, and father of SĪTĀ.
E.
जन to be born, and ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-ता)
The property of generation, productiveness, paternity.
E.
जनक, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जनकत्वं.

f. (-जा)
A name of SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA.
E.
जनक as above, and आत्मजा daughter; also similar compounds, as जनकतनया, जनकसुता, &c.

m. (-मः)
A Caṇḍāla, a man of a low or degraded tribe.
E.
जन a mean man, and गम to go, खच् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Mankind, a number of men.
2

Manhood.
3

Generation, birth.
E.
जन a man, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जनत्वं.

f. (-त्रा)
An umbrella or parasol.
E.
जन the person, and त्रा saving; from sun and rain.

n. (-नं)
1 Birth, production.
2 Family, race, lineage.
f. (-नी)
1 A mother.
2 Tenderness, compassion.
3 A plant, commonly Chakawat; also जननि and जनी.
4 A bat.
5 Arabian jasmin.
6 Valerian.
mf. (-नः-नी)
A parent, a progenitor.
E.
जन to bear or be born, affix ल्युट्, and ङीष्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Knowing, understanding.
E.
ज्ञा to know, तङ् aff.

f. (-निः)
1 A fragrant plant: see the preceding.
2 Birth, production.
E.
जन to be born, affix अनि.

m. (-दः)
1 Any inhabited country.
2 Man, mankind.
E.
जन man, and पद going.

m. (-दः)
1 Man, mankind.
2 An inhabited country.
E.
जनपद the same, and अण् aff.

m. (-दः)
Rumour, report.
E.
जन man, and प्रवाद speech, from वद to speak, with प्र prefixed, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Agreeable to mankind.
2 Philanthropic.
m. (-यः)
1 Coriander seed.
2 A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera.)
E.
जन, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-यः)
1 The name of a king, son and successor to PARĪ

KṢIT.
2

A son of PURU.
E.
जन in the second case, the world, एजृ to shine, affix खश्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Begetting, engendering, producing.
E.
जन to be born, causal form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Generating, begetting, producing, who or what does so.
m. (-ता)
A father, a progenitor.
f. (-त्री)
A mother.
E.
जन in the causal form, to give birth, to engender, affix तृच्.

m. (-वः)
1 Rumour, report.
2 Calumny, scandal.
E.
जन, and रव sound.

m. (-कः)
One of the seven Lokas or divisions of the world, the fifth, next above MAHARLOKA, where the sons of BRAHMĀ, and other pious men, reside.
E.
जन man, and लोक a world.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Kind to or fond of mankind.
E.
जन, and वल्लभ a friend.

m. (-दः)
News, rumour, report.
E.
जन man, and वाद speech: see जनप्रवाद.

f. (-तिः)
News, tidings, intelligence.
E.
जन mankind, and श्रुति that which is heard.

n. (-नं)
The forest Daṇḍaka, (in the Dekhin,) the eastern part of it.
E.
जन a world, and स्थान a place; the resort of a world of demons.

m. (-रः)
Propriety, decorum, good conduct.
E.
जन mankind, and आचार moral observance.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Superior, superhuman.
E.
जन, and अतिग going beyond.

m. (-थः)
1 VIṢṆ

A king.
E.
जन, and अधिनाथ supreme lord.

m. (-नौः)
A preserver or protector of mankind.
E.
जन, and अव to preserve, क्विन् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A district, an inhabited country.
E.
जन man, and अन्त boundary.

n. (-क्रं)
Secret communication, whispering, speaking aside, &c.
E.
जन man, and अन्तिक near.

m. (-नः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
जन mankind, and अर्द्दन worshipping; whom men worship.

m. (-नः)
A wolf.
E.
जन, and अशन food.

m. (-यः)
A temporary hall.
E.
जन man, and आश्रय an asylum.

f. (-निः or -नी)
1 A woman in general.
2 A mother.
3 Birth, production.
4 The wife of a son, or brother's son, &c.
5 A fragrant plant; see जतूका.
E.
जन to be born or to bear, Uṇādi affix इन्, and optionally ङीष् added.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Producing.
f. (-का)
A woman, a wife, a mother.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Engendered, begotten.
2 Occasioned, occurring, produced.
E.
जन to be born, causal form, क्त aff.

m. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sounding, making a noise.
E.
जनित, स्वन sound.

m. (-ता)
A father.
f. (-त्री)
A mother.
E.
जन to be born, (from whom,) तृच् affix; and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Vigorous, energetic, making exertion.
E.
जनित, and उद्यम effort.

m. (-त्वः)
A father.
f. (-त्वा)
A mother.
E.
जन to be born, (from whom,) and इत्व Uṇādi aff.

m. (-मा)
Birth, engenderment.
E.
जन to be born, इमन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Appropriate, good for, suitable.
E.
जन, and ख aff.

f. (-नुः)
Birth.
E.
जन to be born, उ Uṇādi affix; also with ऊ affix जनू, f. (-नूः)

m. (-नुः)
The knee.
E.
जन to be produced, (walking, motion,) ञुन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नुः)
Birth.
E.
जन to be born, Uṇādi affix उसि.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Desired or prized by mankind.
f. (-ष्टा)
Turmeric.
E.
जन, and इष्ट wished.

n. (-णं)
Fame, glory.
E.
जन mankind, and उदाहरण pre-eminence.

n. (-घं)
A multitude, a mob.
E.
जन, and ओघ a heap.

m. (-न्तुः)
Any animal, any being endowed with animal life; it is more usually applied however to beings of the lowest organization.
E.
जन to be born, तु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-म्बुः)
A shell, a snail's shell, &c.
E.
जन्तु, and कम्बु a shell.

f. (-का)
Lac.
E.
कन् added to जन्त

nf. (-घ्नं-घ्नी)
1 A plant, and vermifuge: see विडङ्ग.
2 Asafoetida.
m. (-घ्नः)
A citron.
E.
जन्तु an animal, (a worm,) and घ्न what destroys.

n. (-नं)
Asafœtida.
E.
जन्तु, and नाशन destroying.

m. (-लः)
Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.)
E.
जन्तु an animal, and फल a leaf; its leaves swarm with insects.

f. (-ला)
A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
जन्तु an animal or insect, and ला what gets.

mn. (-न्मः-न्मं)
Birth: see जन्मन्.

m. (-लः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
जन्म birth, and कील the stay.

m. (-दः)
A father.
E.
जन्म birth, and द who gives.

n. (-न्म)
Birth, production.
E.
जन to be born, and मनिन् Uṇādi affix, or with a final vowel जन्म.

n. (-त्रं)
The planet or constellation under which a person is born.
E.
जन्म, and नक्षत्र asterism.

f. (-मिः)
Native country, birthplace.
E.
जन्म, and भूमि land.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Mortal, living.
E.
जन्म, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-र्त्म)
The vulva.
E.
जन्म birth, and वर्त्मन् path or way.

n. (-ण्यं)
Acting contrary to one's origin, unbecoming one's birth, &c.
E.
जन्म, and वैलक्षण्य inconsistency.

n. (-नं)
Acquitting the obligations derived from birth.
E.
जन्म, and शोधन wiping away.

n. (-ल्यं)
Attainment of the object or end of existence.
E.
जन्म, and साफल्य fruitfulness.

n. (-रं)
1 The other world.
2 Regeneration, another birth.
E.
जन्म, and अन्तर difference.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Blind from birth.
E.
जन्म, and अन्ध blind.

f. (-मी)
The eighth lunation or dark half of Bhadra, the birth day of KṚṢṆA.
E.
जन्म, and अष्टमी eighth.

m. (-न्मी)
An animal, an existent being.
E.
जन्म birth, and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
The name of a prince: see जनमेजय.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 To be born or produced.
2 Fit for or favourable to men.
m. (-न्यः)
1 A father. The friend, attendant, or companion of a bridegroom.
f. (-न्या)
The friend of a mother.
2 The relation or companion of a bride, a bridesmaid, &c.
3 Pleasure, happiness.
4

Affection.
5

A mother.
n. (-न्यं)
1 War, combat.
2 Rumour, report.
3 A market, a fair.
4 A portent, one occurring at birth.
E.
जन to be born, &c. affix यत्, or Uṇādi affix युक्.

m. (-न्युः)
1 An animal, an existent and sentient being.
2 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
3

Fire or Agni.
E.
जन to be born, &c. Uṇādi affix युच्.

f. (-की)
A name of SĪTĀ.
E.
जनक the father of this lady. affixes अण् and ङीष्.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
Knowing, understanding.
E.
ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.

n. (-कं)
The knee pan or patella.
E.
जानु, and फलक a layer.

f. (-न्धिः)
The knee joint.
E.
जानु, and सन्धि articulation.
